guides.name: Winterspring Frostsaber
steps: Use an Alliance character. Fast alternative during Classic Timewalking: visit Bobadormu at the Stormwind Embassy (56.0, 19.0), buy Commendation of the Wintersaber Trainers for 50 Timewarped Badges each, and use enough to reach Exalted. If you reached Wintersaber Trainers Exalted instead, open Rivern's vendor window and buy the reins for 80 gold; you can skip raising the cub. Use Reins of the Winterspring Frostsaber to learn the mount.

guides.name: Rivendare's Deathcharger
steps: Set dungeon difficulty to Normal and enter Stratholme through the SERVICE ENTRANCE / Eastwall Gate in Eastern Plaguelands (43.3, 19.7). Check the dungeon map: you want Service Entrance / the Gauntlet. If it loads Main Gate, leave, reset all instances, then re-enter through the service gate.

Kill Baroness Anastari, Nerub'enkan and Maleki the Pallid at the three ziggurats. After each boss, enter its ziggurat and kill every Thuzadin Acolyte inside. All three crystals must be disabled to open the way to Slaughter Square.
Enter Slaughter Square and kill all the abominations. Kill Ramstein the Gorger when he emerges, then finish the undead wave and Black Guard Sentries so the Slaughterhouse opens.

Kill Lord Aurius Rivendare inside and loot him for a chance at Deathcharger's Reins. The drop is random; kill order, crates and speed do not guarantee it. The old Baron name in comments refers to this same mount farm.

If the reins did not drop, return outside the instance, choose Reset All Instances on your portrait and run it again. Pause at the hourly instance limit. Old Dreamwalk/follower-dungeon exit tricks have had graveyard bugs; walking out is the dependable route.
When the reins drop, use them to learn Rivendare's Deathcharger. Either faction can learn and ride it.

guides.name: Blue Qiraji Battle Tank
steps: Go through the Scarab Wall in southern Silithus to Ahn'Qiraj: The Fallen Kingdom. Enter the TEMPLE of Ahn'Qiraj / AQ40 portal (46.8, 7.5 on the Fallen Kingdom map). The Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj / AQ20 portal is the wrong instance.
Inside the Temple, kill and loot the first Anubisath Sentinel packs and Obsidian Eradicators before The Prophet Skeram. Leave Skeram alive if you want to repeat this entrance-trash route.
